title: X-Men: Children of the Atom
note: Capcom CPS2 fighting game: health, health_p2, time, power, power_level, power_p2, power_level_p2, 13 characters (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

health.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x8F (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL1)

health_p2.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x8F (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy PL2)

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in % of the current level, full = 0x8E (FBNeo cheat database)

power_level.note: super gauge level of player 1, 3 at most (FBNeo cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in % of the current level, full = 0x8E (FBNeo cheat database)

power_level_p2.note: super gauge level of player 2, 3 at most (FBNeo cheat database)

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character (FBNeo cheat database, Select Character PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet

score_p2.note: player 2 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet (a two-player game), 0x400 further like his health

rounds.note: rounds won by player 1, counted at the K.O., found in RAM captures on a cabinet

rounds_p2.note: rounds won by player 2, counted at the K.O., found in RAM captures on a cabinet

backdrop.note: stage backdrop, picks the HD theme in hd.stages (FBNeo cheat database, Select Background)

_p1_ctl.note: player 1 controlled by a human (1) or the computer, found in RAM captures on a cabinet (a game on each side)

_p2_ctl.note: player 2 controlled by a human (1) or the computer, found in RAM captures on a cabinet (a game on each side)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

hd.note: HD theme and place shown for each backdrop value (index = value), made by tools/cps_games.py from the stages of the cheat database, see README, HD themes
